references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, it is described how contact with dead bodies of unclean animals makes a person unclean, which is further explained in verse 36.
Running water (living water) is used for ritual cleansing, which explains why springs and wells with collected water remain clean.
Running water is used in the purification ritual with the ashes of the red heifer, confirming the cleansing function of the water.
Water is used to cleanse objects that have become unclean, parallel to the principle of the purity of collected waters.
The prophecy about a spring that will be opened for the house of David for cleansing from sin and uncleanness, which builds on the concept of cleansing water sources.
Jesus speaks of living water that gives eternal life, which can be seen in connection with the pure water springs in the Old Testament.
Jesus refers to streams of living water that will flow from the believer, an image rooted in the concept of clean, living water sources.
